name: Exp_ColorXdinMA_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXdinMA_StDev custom indicator, which combines a dual-length XdinMA moving average with standard deviation filtering. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct trend detection, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXdinMA_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了双长度XdinMA移动平均线和标准差过滤。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接趋势检测或禁用）用于入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于ColorXdinMA_StDev指标的趋势跟踪系统，该指标融合了双参数XdinMA平滑均线（Length_main和Length_plus）与标准差通道过滤。入场条件分为三种模式：点信号模式（POINT）检测指标缓冲区2-5中的彩色点信号；直接模式（DIRECT）通过均线的拐点判断趋势转向；禁用模式（WITHOUT）则不产生信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可使用卖出点信号或均线下行判断，卖出平仓同理。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额的比例计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，并设置了1000点止损和2000点止盈。标准差倍数dK1和dK2用于过滤低波动性信号，提高入场质量。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a trend-following system based on the ColorXdinMA_StDev indicator, which integrates dual-parameter XdinMA smoothed moving averages (Length_main and Length_plus) with a standard deviation channel filter. Entry conditions come in three modes: POINT mode detects colored dot signals from indicator buffers 2-5; DIRECT mode identifies trend reversals via moving average inflection points; WITHOUT mode disables signal generation entirely. Exit conditions also support three modes — buy positions can close via sell dot signals or declining MA detection, and vice versa for sell positions. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, and percentage of balance after losses. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio, with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. Standard deviation multipliers dK1 and dK2 filter out low-volatility signals to improve entry quality.

parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

pros: 多种信号模式灵活可选，适应不同交易偏好
标准差通道过滤有效减少虚假信号
支持五种仓位管理模式，资金管理灵活
止损止盈参数完整，风险可控
新K线检测机制避免重复信号
pros_en: Multiple signal modes offer flexibility to adapt to different trading preferences
Standard deviation channel filter effectively reduces false signals
Five position sizing modes provide flexible money management options
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters ensure controllable risk
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signal processing
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标ColorXdinMA_StDev，指标文件缺失则无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能不适合小周期交易
缺少点差过滤，短线交易时可能因高点差受损
信号模式组合复杂，新手容易配置不当
缺乏对持仓数量和同向重复开仓的显式检查
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator ColorXdinMA_StDev; missing file prevents execution
Default 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP are large, unsuitable for lower timeframes
No spread filter, risking losses from high spreads on short-term trades
Complex signal mode combinations can lead to misconfiguration by beginners
Lacks explicit checks for position count and duplicate same-direction entries
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制
添加指标有效性检查和更完善的错误处理日志
improvements_en: Add spread filter and maximum position count limits
Add indicator validity checks and more comprehensive error handling logging

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高波动时段滑点风险较大
无最大持仓数量限制，可能连续开仓导致过度暴露
依赖外部指标文件，指标加载失败时仅返回INIT_FAILED无降级方案
risk_points_en: No spread filter creates significant slippage risk during high-volatility periods
No maximum position count limit may lead to consecutive openings and overexposure
Depends on external indicator file with no fallback if indicator load fails
